chair_roll.path: offset = roll * smootherstep(s) (quintic: zero velocity and acceleration at both ends)

seam_windows.fingers: captured curls kept on every frame (all-frame invariance gate)

seat_sole_gates_at_rolled_chair.frames: every 10th frame (the rigid roll keeps the chair-relative geometry)

left_sole.unseated_note: stepping frames lift a foot genuinely; only penetration is counted there

right_sole.unseated_note: stepping frames lift a foot genuinely; only penetration is counted there

left.rule: contact at the seam frame 36; penetration <= 0.1 cm on every frame

right.rule: hand not on the keys at the seam frame 36 (capture and neighbour): penetration <= 0.1 cm on every frame

seat_main_strong_rule.rule: origin/main tools/validate_unreal_seat_contact.py validate() @ 9792a35 (median gap <= band high, coverage >= 0.5)

fingers.rule:
Finger gate on EVERY frame. Outside the seam windows: every finger local equals the clip's capture within
FINGER_LOCAL_GATE_DEG. Inside a full-pose seam window (weight w toward a neighbour pose whose fingers are that
neighbour's capture): every finger local equals slerp(capture, neighbour capture, w) within FINGER_LOCAL_GATE_DEG,
and every per-frame finger step is at most the largest step either capture itself makes in the same time
(max captured angular speed x dt) + FINGER_LOCAL_GATE_DEG. Overlapping windows compose in order.

chair.rule: body skin (every 6th vertex) signed distance to the complete chair minus the allowed depth (upholstery: the seat band lower edge -2.5 cm; every other part 0) > 0; complete chair vs the real desk part boxes > 0; lowest chair point >= the 2.5 cm floor
